label: Late copy phase: last two outputs (token-dependent)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original tokens or <DEL>, and only on repeated inputs (in_first=0). Strongly concentrated at the end of the copy: to_go=0 holds 49% of activation mass, to_go=1 26%, to_go=2 13%, never with to_go>=6. Strongest activations are the final step of L=3 sequences (e.g. c v z <DEL> c [v]). Within the window, firing depends on token identity (in_tok v, r, i, d rate ~2-3x; out_tok g, q, e, c) and fires on only ~22% of last-two copy steps, so precision is low; L=5 sequences rarely fire. Token-set conditions did not improve F1. Predicate covers ~75% of mass at ~22% precision.
